notes.title: Publisher Hooked! - Normal Fishing to be published by Pocketpair Publishing!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! [/p][p][/p][p]We have some exciting news to share today! [/p][p]Normal Publishing will be published by Pocketpair Publishing! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/yz-oET2684o"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Pocketpair Publishing will be helping us out with both funding and marketing support. We're really excited about what this means for the game, and we can't wait to show you all more soon! [/p][p]Don't forget to wishlist to keep up to date, and we'll see you all soon!
